title: Collections: Dunning Schedule for Overdue Invoices
author: Emily Stone
body:
## Scope
Invoices still unpaid after their due date, once any automatic payment retries have finished.

## Schedule
| Days past due | Step |
|---|---|
| 3 | Reminder email to the billing contact |
| 10 | Second reminder; account team copied |
| 30 | Final notice |
| 45 | Hosted API access suspended until paid |

_Last reviewed 2026-01-19._
